highlights: Put-Up: Went bad asks how many when several are left, so you can mark only the ones that spoiled
Back inside Put-Up returns to where you came from (the Pantry, a recipe, a batch), and the phone's Back no longer re-opens what you just left
Start a batch from one of your recipes or from a past batch, right on the Start sheet
A Pantry jar names the batch it came from, and its sheet opens what went in
Moving a jar says what happens to its discard date before you save
Put it up opens on Today, with both buttons in one row
Recipes: a clearer recipe sheet, bold and italic in notes, and Made it, ate it all
The Put-Up search finds recipes as well as the Pantry
A page on your tab bar now shows its own dot — Release Notes for a new release, Critters for a new visitor
The Release Notes dot no longer clears itself when the app can't reach the server at launch
